tax.text: She supported making the 2017 tax cuts permanent and said the 2025 bill would prevent a tax hike.
tax.quote: Today, thanks to the hard work of the Ways and Means Republicans, we will make those tax cuts permanent and prevent an end of the year tax hike.

wages.text: She voted against House passage of the Raise the Wage Act.
wages.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Raise the Wage Act

immigration.text: She endorsed securing the southern border and deporting undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: securing the southern border, deporting illegal immigrants, and eliminating fentanyl from the United States.

guns.text: She voted against the Bipartisan Background Checks Act of 2021.
guns.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Bipartisan Background Checks Act

abortion.text: She praised the Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v. Wade and said unborn life must be protected.
abortion.quote: An unborn child is a human life that must be protected.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: She voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which bases eligibility on sex at birth.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

energy.text: She promoted coal, liquefied natural gas, and oil exports alongside carbon-capture efforts.
energy.quote: our ample supplies of coal, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and oil can position the United States as a leader in international energy exportation

voting.text: She voted for House passage of the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act.
voting.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act

wages.text: He says he would fight to double the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: If elected, I will fight to double the federal minimum wage.

debt.text: He supports fully funding Social Security and opposes cuts to Medicare and other safety-net programs.
debt.quote: I support fully funding SNAP, Social Security, and veterans’ benefits, and I oppose harmful funding cuts to safety net programs.

immigration.text: He says immigration enforcement is important while criticizing ICE actions and supporting due-process protections.
immigration.quote: Immigration enforcement is important. But ICE is violating people’s rights, engaging in federal overreach, and encroaching on West Virginia’s local communities.

health.text: He supports a Medicare-for-All option and says he would fight to reverse cuts to Medicaid and Medicare.
health.quote: Expanding affordable healthcare access, including a Medicare-for-All option

voting.text: He says he wants to register more people and expand voter turnout.
voting.quote: I am passionate about getting folks registered to vote, expanding voter turnout, and helping voters make informed decisions.

tax.text: She called for middle-class tax cuts and firm caps on government spending.
tax.quote: Increase transparency—tax cuts for the middle-class. And firm caps on government spending.

debt.text: She strongly agreed that the government should cut spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt. Strongly Agree

safety.text: She disagreed with redirecting police funding to mental-health and community programs.
safety.quote:
I support redirecting funds from police departments to mental health and community programs.
Disagree

immigration.text: She strongly agreed that the United States should secure the southern border and said immigration should be legal only.
immigration.quote: The U.S. should do more to physically secure the southern border. Strongly Agree

guns.text: She said she fully supports the Second Amendment and strongly disagreed that gun-violence victims should be able to sue firearms dealers and manufacturers.
guns.quote: What restrictions on gun ownership are needed to protect public safety? I fully support the 2nd Amendment. Victims of gun violence should be able to sue firearms dealers and manufacturers. Strongly Disagree

abortion.text: She described herself as pro-life in her campaign materials and questionnaire.
abortion.quote: Under what circumstances should abortion be allowed? I'm pro-life.

energy.text: Her platform says fossil fuels should remain part of the economy and calls for eliminating excessive regulations.
energy.quote: We cannot strip the economy by completing eliminating fossil fuels. And we must eliminate excessive regulations that make agriculture production and innovation more difficult.

voting.text: She strongly disagreed that people should be able to vote without photo identification and called for photo ID and legal-citizen voting.
voting.quote: People should be able to vote without photo identification. Strongly Disagree
